            前端技巧：检测到省略号文本自动显示 Tooltip

                    阅读1分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">前言</h2>
<p>在前端开发中，我们经常会遇到接口返回的文本内容过长，无法完全显示的问题。为了处理这一问题，通常会设置固定的宽度并使用省略号样式（<code>text-overflow: ellipsis</code>）来隐藏超出的文本。然而，有时产品需求还希望用户能够通过悬停查看完整内容，这时就需要引入 Tooltip 进行展示。（没被省略的时候不要显示Tooltip）</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">// tailwind的样式单行省略
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.line-clamp-1</span> {  
    <span class="hljs-attribute">overflow</span>: hidden;  
    <span class="hljs-attribute">display</span>: -webkit-box;  
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;  
    -webkit-line-clamp: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;  
}

// 自行设置的css样式
single-line {
    <span class="hljs-attribute">overflow</span>: hidden;
    <span class="hljs-attribute">white-space</span>: nowrap;
    <span class="hljs-attribute">text-overflow</span>: ellipsis;
}
</code></pre>
<p>为了解决这个问题，我们实现了一个自定义 Hook，该 Hook 会监测文本元素是否因宽度限制而被省略。一旦检测到文本内容被省略，Hook 会自动为该元素添加 Tooltip，确保用户可以方便地查看完整信息。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">代码实现</h2>
<p><code>use-ellipsis.ts</code></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useEffect, useRef, useState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Options</span> = {
  lines?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 支持多行</span>
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> useEllipsis&lt;T <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span>&gt;({
  lines = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
}: <span class="hljs-title class_">Options</span> = {}) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ref = useRef&lt;T&gt;(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [isEllipsis, setIsEllipsis] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);

  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> el = ref.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!el) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">check</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (lines === <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">setIsEllipsis</span>(el.<span class="hljs-property">scrollWidth</span> &gt; el.<span class="hljs-property">clientWidth</span>);
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">setIsEllipsis</span>(el.<span class="hljs-property">scrollHeight</span> &gt; el.<span class="hljs-property">clientHeight</span>);
      }
    };

    <span class="hljs-title function_">check</span>();
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, check);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, check);
    };
  }, [lines]);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { ref, isEllipsis };
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>ellipsis-tooltip.tsx</code></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Tooltip</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@arco-design/web-react'</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 或 antd / 你自己的库</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useEllipsis } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/hooks/use-ellipsis.ts'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { cn } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/lib/utils.ts'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">EllipsisTooltipProps</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  className?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  onClick?: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  lines?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">EllipsisTooltip</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>.<span class="hljs-property">FC</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">EllipsisTooltipProps</span>&gt; = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">{
  text,
  className,
  onClick,
  lines = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
}</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { ref, isEllipsis } = useEllipsis&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLDivElement</span>&gt;({ lines });

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> lineClass =
    lines === <span class="hljs-number">1</span> ? <span class="hljs-string">'truncate whitespace-nowrap'</span> : <span class="hljs-string">`line-clamp-<span class="hljs-subst">${lines}</span>`</span>;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> content = (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">ref</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{ref}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{cn(lineClass,</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>)} <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{onClick}</span>&gt;</span>
      {text}
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> isEllipsis ? <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Tooltip</span> <span class="hljs-attr">content</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{text}</span>&gt;</span>{content}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Tooltip</span>&gt;</span></span> : content;
};

</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">使用示例与效果</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">TestPage</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mockText = <span class="hljs-string">'很长很长很长很长很长'</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mockText2 = <span class="hljs-string">'简短的'</span>;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">EllipsisTooltip</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">'w-28'</span> <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{mockText}</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">EllipsisTooltip</span> <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{mockText2}</span> /&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/&gt;</span></span>
  );
}

</code></pre>
